name: SCROOMS 🍄
desc:
🍄 Welcome to SCROOMS 🍄

Step into a world where peculiar little creatures called Scrooms can't resist a good tune. Pick up an instrument, play them a song, and tame everything from common Redcaps to the rarest Eversung. Explore various areas, uncover their secrets, and become the best Scroom tamer out there!


▪ Equip your instrument and start playing to draw a Scroom in
▪ Tune your instrument before the Scroom commits. A faster Tune Speed makes this quicker
▪ Keep the Scroom inside the catch zone to fill your progress bar. If it slips out, your progress drains, so stay on it!
▪ When the progress bar is full, the Scroom is yours!

Credit to Blotnik for the clothing.

llm.loop: play instrument to lure a Scroom -> tune and keep it in the catch zone minigame -> tame it -> sell/enchant -> explore new areas for rarer Scrooms
llm.objectives: tame every Scroom up to the rarest Eversung and become the best tamer
llm.progression: Scroom rarity, catch EXP, instrument stats (tune speed), areas, 36 badges
llm.instructions: equip instrument and play to draw a Scroom, tune before it commits, keep it in the catch zone until the bar fills
unique: fishing-style catch minigame reskinned as playing music to tame mushroom creatures
llm.thumbnails: cute mushroom creatures, player with lute/guitar, music notes, glowing Scrooms
llm.complexity_notes: multiple areas, custom creature models and animations, catch minigame, 36 badges
